description: Counts the claims one BandIt rule proposal offers, from their de-identified copies in the claims index: one row per outcome (approved or refused), diagnosis code (ICD-10-CM) and kind of item, with the number of claims, their claim ids, the highest and lowest payout in cents and the service codes (CPT or HCPCS). A claim with two diagnosis codes is counted under each. Pass claims_index and doc_ids exactly as the task gives them.

configuration.query: FROM bandit*-claims METADATA _index | WHERE _index == ?claims_index AND MV_CONTAINS(SPLIT(?doc_ids, ","), doc_id) | STATS claims = COUNT_DISTINCT(claim_id), claim_ids = VALUES(claim_id), highest_payout_cents = MAX(payout_cents), lowest_payout_cents = MIN(payout_cents), service_codes = VALUES(service_codes) BY outcome, diagnosis_codes, item_kind | SORT outcome, claims DESC | LIMIT 50

claims_index.description: The claims index, exactly as given in the task, for example bandit-claims.

doc_ids.description: The ids of the offered claims' copies, comma-separated, exactly as given in the task, for example claim-2-v2,claim-4-v2,claim-7-v2.
